build_train_iterator: build a training data iterator with shuffling, caching, batching, and prefetching from a TensorFlow dataset
build_prediction_iterator: build a prediction data iterator with batching and prefetching from a TensorFlow dataset without shuffling
configure_cache_threshold: configure the DATASET_SIZE_TO_CACHE threshold to control when small datasets are cached in memory
apply_preproc_fn: apply a preprocessing function to each batch using tf.data.AUTOTUNE for parallel processing
create_batch_iterator: create a numpy batch iterator from a TensorFlow dataset using tfds.as_numpy for JAX compatibility
